name: split_adjusted_holding_period_return
question_template: An investor buys {N} shares at USD {P0} each. The company then executes a {S}-for-1 stock split. After the split, a cash dividend of USD {D} per post-split share is paid, and the investor later sells all post-split shares at USD {P1} each. Compute the holding-period return in percent = (sale proceeds + total dividends - purchase cost) / purchase cost x 100. Use exact arithmetic.

slots.description: Number of shares held after the split.
Total cash dividends on post-split shares.
Total proceeds from selling post-split shares.

program:
def solve():
    n = P["N"]
    p0 = P["P0"]
    s = P["S"]
    d = P["D"]
    p1 = P["P1"]
    cost = n * p0
    shares_post = n * s
    dividends = shares_post * d
    proceeds = shares_post * p1
    hpr = Fraction(proceeds + dividends - cost, 1) / cost * 100
    return {
        "final": hpr,
        "post_split_share_count": shares_post,
        "post_split_dividend_cash": dividends,
        "post_split_sale_value": proceeds
    }
